DisputeVotesCast.meaning: Two votes on one side already decide this case, so it can't be linked or linked again. Open a new case and link that one.

ReleaseNotAuthorized.meaning: Only the payer can release an open escrow; after an upheld dispute, the payer or the payee.

DisputePending.meaning: Release stays blocked while the dispute is unresolved or was unwound. A refund before the claim ends stays blocked until the panel unwinds the deal. A refund also stays blocked when the panel upheld the deal.
